shared.item_highlight: Ganpati Bandhanwar with Pearl Tassel | Main Door, Mandir and Pooja Room Wall Hanging | Griha Pravesh and Wedding Decor
shared.description: A Ganesha at the doorway is how many Indian homes begin every festival, and this latkan keeps him there all season. Each strand carries a painted MDF Ganesha at the centre, a white lotus bud above and below him, five gold-finish bells, yellow and rani pink fabric flowers, and a pearl tassel with flower drops that sways and catches the light every time the door opens. Hang one on each side of the main door frame, on either side of the mandir, or behind the Ganpati idol for Ganesh Chaturthi. It works just as well for Diwali, Dhanteras, Lakshmi Puja, Navratri, Griha Pravesh and wedding entrances. Unlike a fresh flower toran, nothing wilts or drops on the floor: dust it with a dry cloth, store it flat in the box, and it is ready again next year. Each latkan has a braided cord loop at the top, so it goes up on a nail, a hook or an adhesive wall hook in seconds. Note: colours can look slightly different on different screens. Keep away from open diya flames.
